findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_letter · Private data: get_coverage, quote_letter, send_letter, get_letter_status · Public sink: send_letter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_letter · Private data: get_coverage, quote_letter, send_letter, get_letter_status · Public sink: send_letter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
